enabled.description: Whether the finger daemon is enabled and should start on boot.

loglevel.description: Verbosity of logging: 0 = quiet, 1 = normal, 2 = verbose.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. If empty or omitted, file logging is disabled (syslog may still be used).

allow_hosts.description: List of hostnames or CIDR subnets permitted to query this finger server. Leave empty to allow all.

items.description: Denied host or subnet (takes precedence over `allow_hosts`).

deny_hosts.description: List of hosts explicitly denied access (e.g., known attackers or misbehaving networks).

banner_host.description: Custom hostname to display in the server banner. Empty uses the system hostname.

banner_text.description: Custom banner message shown before user data (single line only).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections the server will accept.

idle_timeout.description: Number of seconds before an idle connection is closed.

show_full_info.description: Whether to show detailed user info (full name, shell, home directory, etc.) in responses.

show_plans.description: Whether to include user's plan/project files (if present) in the output.

obfuscate_email.description: Whether to obfuscate email addresses (e.g., `user@example.com` → `user AT example DOT com`).

hidden_groups.description: List of group names whose members should be hidden from non-local queries (if supported by implementation).

port.description: TCP port to listen on. Set to 0 to disable standalone mode (use only with inetd/xinetd).

bind_address.description: IP address to bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost-only). Empty means all interfaces.
